title: Maximum Number of Items From Sale II
summary: Buy unlimited item copies within budget. Each purchased copy may grant at most one free copy of a different type whose factor is divisible by the purchased type's factor. Each ordered source/recipient type pair can grant at most once overall. Different source types may grant the same recipient type. Maximize purchased plus free copies; free copies do not generate grants.
officialConstraints: 1..100000 types; factor 1..number of types; prices and budget 1..10^9.
exampleStatus: Author and independently check examples; no source examples copied into public presets.
